mission: Pure causal failure-to-ignite test of a completed 3H MACD reversal on one index, several semis, and regime controls
frozen_signal: First completed 3H MACD8/21/5 negative-but-rising histogram, StochRSI14 rising and K>=D after 2x80RMS downside extension and oversold <=20, next available observed 15m opening fill
base_exit: 1.5% entry-price emergency stop always active, 25% original position profit taken at +2% if touched, other shares timed-out at 52 observed regular-session hours, next-open fills, 5bp/side, stop-first
probe: At precisely three observed RTH hours since entry, after the completed five-minute candle closes: if remaining position and close < original entry opening price, sell remaining at next recorded five-minute opening; evaluate once only. The hard emergency stop stays active and has precedence.
comparison: Same-entry without 3h ignition rule, no change to stop, target, fee, source, higher timeframe signal, horizon, position unit
metrics: mean net lift by trade and per original 3H event
cluster bootstrap by market week and asset equal weighting
source_requirements: Terminal existing public read-only intraday 15m and5m (30m optional completeness), ET display epochs restored to zoned ET; reject any study-year missing date/internal 5m bar, historical price adjustment/PIT unverified
new_data_access: Only Terminal's existing public read endpoint; never directly contact paid vendor APIs or use credentials, no changes to Macro source writer
precommit_falsifier: Even if this saves SOXX losers, do not promote unless new semis avoid meaningful prior-winner harm and cross-stock net lift is positive with uncertainty excluding zero. No threshold changes to 3h condition after viewing results.
test_coverage: Eligibility at 3h can be absent because initial stop exits first. Partial profit sale does not exempt remainder from original stop or time horizon.
market_data_licenses: Retain 5m/15m OHLCV privately; only code, hashes and derived research summaries to GitHub.
